scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @nginap/web" "npm run dev --workspace @nginap/local-server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nginap/web && npm run build --workspace @nginap/local-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @nginap/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @nginap/local-server
